text:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: proposing to remove temporary runtime pin v3.2.1 -> runtime v3.3 across hosted for model-family llama3q. Reason: pin introduced earlier for kvcache regression was reverted in runtime v3.3. Canary plan attached. 

maria: @deploy-bot can you paste the canary config and which regions are affected? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary config: 5% of traffic, regions: us-west1, eu-west1. Fallback: runtime v3.2.1 pinned if error rate > 3% or p95 latency +30% over baseline. 
sam: what's the SDK surface change here? Do clients need an SDK bump?

maria: SDK shouldn't need bump for surface, but we do have a known issue with longseq KV eviction in v3.3 on quantized models — QA flagged it yesterday. 

ivy: ran quick longseq perf test on dev with quant-v4b model. Results: 
```
95th_latency_baseline_ms: 210
95th_latency_v3.3_ms: 310
error_rate: 0.6%
```
That p95 increase is for one config; not full signal but worth watching.

oliver: Suggest phased region rollout: start eu-west1 only at 5% then us-west1 at 5% an hour later if metrics stable. Also recommend routing policy that prefers non-quantized variants for canary to reduce risk.

maria: +1 to phased. Also we should run the e2e prompt-regression suite (quick subset) before increasing. @qa-bot can you kick that off?

qa-bot: Kicking off reg-suite subset now. Tests: prompt-coherence, streaming-shutdown, kv-eviction-longseq. ETA 12m. Will post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam: If kv-eviction is flaky, we might need to hold the hosted unpin and only unpin Dedicated where customers have control. Some enterprise customers rely on v3.2.1 for SLAs.

ivy: FYI I repro'd a kv-eviction spike in a stress harness when sequence > 65k tokens on quant-v4b. We have a small fix but needs canary validation.

oliver: Can deploybot set a region-level override so dedicated/enterprise stays pinned? We shouldn't touch dedicated without account owner consent.

maria: Absolutely not touching Dedicated. Proposal update: hosted-only, phased eu-west1 canary 5% -> hold for 30m run e2e subset -> if pass then expand to us-west1 5% and run full regression overnight. Dedicated unchanged.

deploy-bot: Updated plan applied: hosted eu-west1 5% canary active. Monitoring hooks: canary-dashboard, alert channel eng-runtime, auto-fallback enabled.

qa-bot: Short-run results: prompt-coherence OK, streaming-shutdown OK, kv-eviction LONGSEQ test failed (memory bump observed, eviction thrash). Attaching short log: 
```
[kv] eviction spikes at 00:12:34
mem_delta_mb: +420
err_rate: 0.5% (retryable)
```

maria: That's the risk I mentioned. We should pause the rollout. Reverting hosted changes now. @deploy-bot please rollback canary to pinned v3.2.1 and escalate to runtime team. :warning:

deploy-bot: Rolling back hosted eu-west1 canary to runtime v3.2.1 now. Action id: RB-1745067890-1. Canary traffic drained. Fallback confirmed.

sam: Thanks. Can we collect traces and heap profiles from the canary instances? I'll take owner for triage.

ivy: I'll upload the stress harness traces and a minimized repro. Putting them in /internal/triage/kv-eviction/1745067890.

oliver: Next steps proposal: 1) runtime team produce hotfix for kv eviction (small change to cache eviction threshold), 2) QA run targeted longseq job against hotfix in staging, 3) re-run hosted phased canary with quant-variant throttling (prefer non-quant for canary), 4) re-evaluate after 4h of stable metrics.

maria: Agree. Also update release notes: mark runtime v3.3 as 'hold: kv-eviction regression for quantized long sequences'. Don't merge change into public docs until hotfix verified.

deploy-bot: Noted. I'll open deploy ticket DT-1745067890 and change notes draft created.

maria: Thanks team. Sam/ivy—please sync on repro and timeline. Oliver I'll take you on the rollback comms to customers affected by the planned hosted change.

sam: On it, starting trace collection now.

ivy: Repro + traces uploaded. Will follow up thread with minimized harness.

oliver: I'll draft a short customer-facing note and channel internal comms after we have hotfix ETA. :memo: "Hosted runtime unpin delayed due to kv-eviction regression on quantized long sequences; dedicated unaffected."

maria: Closing this thread for the current attempt. We'll re-open when hotfix passes QA. :lock:
